learnings.remediation: a dependency-table key with a package value is a local alias: read the real name from spec['package'] and keep the alias out of the identity
learnings.source: greptile pr-24 findings 11/20: serde1 = { package = "serde" } reported an unrelated crate named serde1

learnings.remediation: keep the declared spec verbatim; only an exact == pin collapses to its version, and a purl carries a version only when the spec pins one
learnings.source: greptile pr-24 findings 8/12: lstrip('=<>~! ') made demo!=1.0 report 1.0 and ranges read as resolved pins

learnings.remediation: read every declared section - npm's four tables, PEP 621 optional-dependencies, PEP 735 dependency-groups, Poetry main/dev/groups, Cargo main/dev/build/target - before calling the inventory complete
learnings.source: greptile pr-24 findings 6/15: this repo's own [dependency-groups] produced no rows and no gap

learnings.remediation: discovery must match the advertised filename pattern (requirements*.txt as a regex), never an exact-name list
learnings.source: greptile pr-24 findings 5/14: requirements-dev.txt and requirements-test.txt were never parsed and produced no gap

learnings.remediation: tests document contracts, not invented incidents; any artifact a review shows is byte-verified against disk before it enters release history
learnings.source: greptile pr-24 findings 22/24/25: a rendering artifact was written up as a shipped outage; the strip-then-compare test would have blessed the mangling

learnings.pattern: AttributeError: ('list' object has no attribute 'items'|'NoneType' object)
learnings.remediation: validate the decoded object and its section shapes before use and raise ValueError, so the scan records a data gap instead of stopping
learnings.source: greptile pr-24 findings 4/26: package.json as [] or a dependency table as an array stopped the whole scan

learnings.remediation: npm scoped names keep the %40 escape, Go module paths and NuGet ids keep declared casing; identity rules are per ecosystem, never one shared lowercase

learnings.pattern: debug-prnit|not a live check id|typo.*clean row
learnings.remediation: external labels are validated against the live check registry (slop_model.REMEDIES) before judging; a typo is a configuration error, never a vacuous clean row
learnings.source: greptile pr-24 finding 23: debug-prnit: clean always scored a correct clean result

learnings.remediation: dependencies carry NOASSERTION; the manifest's license is a project license reported separately, never stamped onto dependency rows
learnings.source: greptile pr-24 findings 1/17: an MIT application made unknown-license deps pass deny_unknown

learnings.pattern: split_case\(case\)|row labels ignore (the )?ratio|counts mix (both splits|training and holdout)
learnings.remediation: judge per case id (the fixture slug the manifest assigns) and read each row's split from the already-computed manifest; never re-hash the case under a default ratio
learnings.source: greptile pr-24 findings 2/3/16/18: stats keyed by rule merged both splits and contradicted the report's own manifest

learnings.remediation: grow every candidate and keep the best (most matched evidence first, then score, then earliest start); one alignment still reports once
learnings.source: greptile pr-24 findings 13/21: min(anchors) let a shared import preamble hide a 14-line near-copy at the same offset

learnings.remediation: parse XML by element and attribute names (ElementTree, namespace-tolerant): attribute order, quoting, extra attributes and child Version elements are all ordinary references
learnings.source: greptile pr-24 findings 7/9: the Include-first regex silently dropped valid references
